The music was written "in the spring, summer and fall of 1975." The premiere took place on July 25, 1976, at the Avignon Festival in France.  The opera contains writings by Christopher Knowles, Samuel M. Johnson and Lucinda Childs. Ramrod (Bruce Springsteen song): "Ramrod" is a song written and performed by Bruce Springsteen for his fifth album, "The River", released in 1980.
